about: Stage 3 clip picks for scene C (2026-10-21 autonomous run). Frame id -> chosen file (relative to media), in/out seconds inside that file, and what the stage 4 assembly needs to know. Every take, prompt and credit is in shots.md; the spend is in scripts/gpom/second-half-video/ending/ledger.json.
engine: Omni 1.1 Flash, Frames (start frame only), 16:9, 720p, x1; 1280x720 24 fps; clips carry Omni's own audio (mute on the timeline)

talking.fit: voice speech 2.38 s over ~2.0 s of mouth = x1.19, inside 1.3

C02.note: Review round 1 re-roll: a light breeze, the cloth hangs limp, nothing rises from the robot. No pennant pole; Maddie leaves frame left at ~7 s.
C02.alt: C02-t1.mp4 (round-0 pick: Omni grew a pole of pennants on her rear from ~1.5 s); C02-t3 rejected (the bunting streamed across the whole foreground)

C03.joins: last->first 2.19 against in-clip medians 2.74/2.96: OK; link 2 trimmed to its first 68 frames (the robot narrows towards the round-0 cart shape after ~3 s)
C03.post: move_keys.py: holds 1.5 s at 160% on Maddie alone (left third), then eases out to 100% by 9.6 s so the line of a hundred appears behind her
